_comment: THE CONVERSATIONAL LOOP — PLAN 2x §3.3. The AI writes this file and bumps `rev`; the Texture panel polls /api/textureparams once a second and regenerates on a rev change. No websocket, no connection state, survives a page reload. `autoplay` is absent BY DESIGN — sound only ever on the composer's SPACE or Play. Every label must NAME THE DIALS IT MOVED (§6's two-sided contract), so the qualitative interface never goes opaque.
_slate: rev 2 (2026-08-20, day 21) — THE SPEED LADDER. One character (SMEAR: jitter 0, scatter 0, unison C3), six speeds. ONLY `bpm` moves across A–F; every other dial is identical. This exists because the five stored models CONFOUND character with speed — TICKS is literally SMEAR at 12/s, GROOVE is scatter at 8/s — so 'do the categories sound different' and 'do the speeds sound different' could not be told apart from the model buttons alone. Landing variant is E (18/s), the speed the SMEAR/RAIN/GALLOP references run at, so ← steps DOWN from what the composer just heard. bpm = density x 6 at 10 players. rev 1 (the A/B/C SMEAR/RAIN/GALLOP reference slate) is recoverable from git.
